[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Health-watch fixes: wait notices name their waiter, failed [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]staged-monitor sessions never park waiters silently, fleet [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]snapshots build within their refresh timeout, and dismissed runs [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]converge in the published agents sidecar[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Every "Wait dependency can never self-resolve" notice names the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]blocked agent (never a project key). An agent waiting on a session [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]whose root turn and monitor both failed is flagged within one [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]wait_checks pass instead of waiting silently. apollo's presentation[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]fleet snapshot builds in well under the gateway's 4 s refresh [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]timeout, so remote fleet readers stop receiving stale "timeout" [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]snapshots every minute. agent_state_refresh finds each run's [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]dismissed bundle by exact identity, so dismissed runs stop being [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]published as active or waiting forever, and an incomplete dismissal[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]lookup is never reported as live.[/#D7D7AF]
